assumptions: The blueprint and research report are already approved and no blueprint revision occurs.
Draft validation and materialization have succeeded. Each payload symbol represents a full saved content tree.
Guard checks and writes are one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction.
Stopped abstracts the equivalent non-ready states after cancellation, failure, or interruption.
Issued results may be delivered repeatedly and arbitrarily late. No fairness is assumed.

actions.BeginUnit: BlueprintStorage.begin_unit transaction, first non-ready unit only
actions.FinishUnit: BlueprintStorage.finish_unit and _units_active transaction, ready/old-owner results rejected
actions.Retry: Database.retry_run and BlueprintStorage._retry_blueprint transaction with ownership transfer
